topics.question: Which prompt gets the better answer?
options: Write 3 Instagram captions for a bakery’s new croissant, in a friendly tone, under 20 words each.
topics.explanation: Specific prompts, with context, format and tone, give the AI what it needs to help.

topics.question: The code the AI gave you doesn’t run. What’s the best next step?
options: Paste the exact error message and ask it to explain and fix it.
topics.explanation: AI fixes code best when it sees the real error. Reading errors is something we practise in class.

topics.question: Which goal is easier to measure?
options: 50 sign-ups from Instagram ads within 30 days.
topics.explanation: Specific, measurable goals with a deadline show you exactly what’s working.

topics.question: An AI tool gives you a statistic for a client report. What do you do?
options: Paste it straight into the report.
Check it against a reliable source first.
topics.explanation: AI can sound confident and still be wrong. Check facts before you share them.

items.question: When are the classes?
items.answer: Classes run live on Google Meet, usually in the evening so you can join after work. The schedule for the next cohort is shown above, and after you enroll you'll also see it on your dashboard.

items.question: What if I miss a class?
items.answer: It happens. Materials from every class are posted on the module page, and you can reach out to your instructor with any questions. Attendance is recorded, so try to join live as often as you can.

items.question: How do the tests work?
items.answer: The test opens in the last week of each module and you take it online. It lasts about 45 minutes, with single-choice, multiple-choice and true/false questions. You pass with 70% or more.

items.question: What if I don't pass?
items.answer: You get two attempts at each test. If you don't pass on the second try, contact us: our team will review your case and can give you another chance.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: There's no online payment. Register and request a seat in a course, and our team will contact you to confirm it and arrange payment.

items.question: What language are the courses in?
items.answer: Albanian. Some tools and terms are in English, but everything is explained in Albanian, step by step.

items.question: What do I need to take part?
items.answer: A computer or laptop with a stable internet connection, a camera and a microphone. Google Meet runs right in your browser. For the coding module, a computer is essential.

items.question: What do I get at the end?
items.answer: Practical skills you'll use at work, the projects you built during the course, and passed tests that show your progress, module by module.
